description: Complete survey of GO:0004867 across all 38 reviewed human serpin-domain proteins, comparing evidence quality between established non-inhibitory serpins and the rest
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, time, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np
pd.set_option("display.width",200); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",45)

q=("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=xref:interpro-IPR023796+AND+organism_id:9606"
   "+AND+reviewed:true&fields=accession,gene_primary&format=json&size=100")
res=requests.get(q,timeout=90).json()["results"]
prot=[(e["primaryAccession"],(e.get("genes") or [{}])[0].get("geneName",{}).get("value","?")) for e in res]

def go4867(acc):
    u=f"https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/services/annotation/search?geneProductId=UniProtKB:{acc}&goId=GO:0004867&limit=100"
    try: r=requests.get(u,headers={"Accept":"application/json"},timeout=60).json()["results"]
    except Exception: return {"n":0,"ev":"","refs":""}
    return {"n":len(r),"ev":",".join(sorted({a["goEvidence"] for a in r})),
            "refs":",".join(sorted({a["reference"] for a in r}))}

# Established non-inhibitory human serpins (literature-defined, not computed)
NONINH={"SERPINA6":"cortisol carrier; PMID:3143075 'no evidence of any retained protease inhibitory activity'",
        "SERPINA7":"thyroxine carrier; same PMID:3143075 conclusion",
        "AGT":"angiotensinogen; hormone precursor, cleaved by renin (an aspartyl protease)",
        "SERPINB11":"human ortholog non-inhibitory (RCL/P1 defect)",
        "SERPINF1":"PEDF; neurotrophic/antiangiogenic, non-inhibitory",
        "SERPINH1":"HSP47; ER collagen-specific chaperone, non-inhibitory"}
EXP={"IDA","IMP","IPI","IGI","IEP","EXP"}

rows=[]
for acc,g in prot:
    d=go4867(acc); time.sleep(0.1)
    evs=set(d["ev"].split(",")) - {""}
    rows.append(dict(gene=g,acc=acc,n=d["n"],evidence=d["ev"],refs=d["refs"],
                     has_exp=bool(evs & EXP),
                     status="NON-INHIBITORY" if g in NONINH else "inhibitory/unclassified",
                     note=NONINH.get(g,"")))
sv=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values(["status","gene"]).reset_index(drop=True)

print("="*150)
print("GO:0004867 across 38 reviewed human serpin-domain proteins (QuickGO, direct goId query)")
print("="*150)
print(sv[["gene","acc","n","evidence","has_exp","status"]].to_string(index=False))

ni=sv[sv.status=="NON-INHIBITORY"]
oth=sv[sv.status!="NON-INHIBITORY"]
print("\n"+"-"*150)
print("ESTABLISHED NON-INHIBITORY HUMAN SERPINS")
print("-"*150)
print(ni[["gene","acc","n","evidence","refs","note"]].to_string(index=False))
print(f"\n  {(ni.n>0).sum()}/{len(ni)} non-inhibitory serpins carry GO:0004867.")
print(f"  {(ni.has_exp).sum()}/{len(ni)} have ANY experimental evidence code for it.")
print(f"  {(oth.n>0).sum()}/{len(oth)} other serpins carry it; {(oth.has_exp).sum()} with experimental evidence.")
print(f"\n  Pseudogene check: SERPINA13P ->", sv[sv.gene=='SERPINA13P'][['n','evidence']].to_dict('records'))

# Fisher: is experimental support independent of inhibitory status?
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
tab=[[int(ni.has_exp.sum()),int(len(ni)-ni.has_exp.sum())],
     [int(oth.has_exp.sum()),int(len(oth)-oth.has_exp.sum())]]
orr,p=fisher_exact(tab)
print(f"\n  Experimental support for GO:0004867, non-inhibitory vs rest: {tab}, Fisher p={p:.4f}")
print("  IBA (GO_REF:0000033) present in:",
      f"{sv.evidence.str.contains('IBA').sum()}/{len(sv)} serpins, including "
      f"{ni.evidence.str.contains('IBA').sum()}/{len(ni)} non-inhibitory ones.")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(15,5.5))
ax=axes[0]
grp=sv.groupby("status").agg(has_term=("n",lambda x:(x>0).sum()),
                             has_exp=("has_exp","sum"),total=("n","size")).reset_index()
x=np.arange(len(grp)); w=0.27
ax.bar(x-w,grp.total,w,label="serpins in group",color="#c9c9c9")
ax.bar(x,grp.has_term,w,label="carry GO:0004867",color="#2e6f9e")
ax.bar(x+w,grp.has_exp,w,label="with experimental evidence",color="#8a1c3b")
for i,r in grp.iterrows():
    for off,v in [(-w,r.total),(0,r.has_term),(w,r.has_exp)]: ax.text(i+off,v+0.4,int(v),ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(["established\nnon-inhibitory","inhibitory /\nunclassified"])
ax.set_ylabel("number of human serpins"); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("Every established non-inhibitory human serpin carries GO:0004867,\nnone with experimental evidence",fontsize=10)

ax=axes[1]; ax.axis("off")
ax.set_title("GO:0004867 evidence on the non-inhibitory serpins",fontsize=10)
ax.text(0.01,0.90,f"{'gene':12s}{'evidence':18s}references",family="monospace",fontsize=9,weight="bold")
for i,(_,r) in enumerate(ni.iterrows()):
    ax.text(0.01,0.78-i*0.12,f"{r.gene:12s}{r.evidence:18s}{r.refs[:52]}",family="monospace",fontsize=8)
ax.text(0.01,0.12,"GO_REF:0000002 = InterPro IPR000215 'Serpin family' -> GO:0004867\nGO_REF:0000033 = GO_Central phylogenetic (IBA)\nTAS references are 1987-1988 cDNA sequence papers.",
        fontsize=9,color="#8a1c3b")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
sv.to_csv("human_serpin_GO0004867_survey.csv",index=False)
print("\nsaved human_serpin_GO0004867_survey.csv")
